modmenu.summaryTranslation.wdl: Plunder the sea ye sail with yer mates an' stow it as a lonely sea ye can sail alone.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.wdl: Keep the seas ye sail with yer mates. As ye roam, the mod stows the land, coffers, beasties, an' treasure maps around ye into a lonely sea ye can sail alone. Everythin' comes from yer own game, so naught runs on the server.

wdl.settings.title: Archive World Downloader Scribble
wdl.settings.defaults.tooltip: All yer scribbles already be at their standard values.
wdl.settings.option.override_gamerules: Override th' rules o' th' sea
wdl.settings.option.zip_on_resume: Backup afore pressin' on or haulin' back
wdl.settings.option.block_tainted_resume: Belay Seas Opened on a Lonely Voyage
wdl.settings.option.append_date_suffix: Add date t' th' sea name
wdl.settings.option.show_hud.tooltip:
Draws th' live plunder status on screen while a plunder runs.
Disablin' hides it; chat messages an' pop up hollers have their own toggles.
wdl.settings.option.hud_anchor.tooltip: Corner o' th' screen th' download HUD drops anchor at.
wdl.settings.option.hud_offset_x.tooltip: Pixel nudge left or right from th' anchor.
wdl.settings.option.hud_offset_y.tooltip: Pixel nudge up or down from th' anchor.
wdl.settings.option.hud_detailed.tooltip: Shows th' detailed multi-line HUD by default. When it be off, th' peek key reveals it live.
wdl.settings.option.hud_peek_mode.toolti: How th' peek key reveals th' detailed HUD: hold it, or flip it per press.
wdl.settings.option.hud_background.toolt:
Draws a panel behind th' HUD.
Disablin' draws th' text wit' a drop shadow instead.
wdl.settings.option.hud_panel_opacity.to: How murky th' HUD panel be when shown.
wdl.settings.option.hud_done_linger_seco: How long th' finished HUD lingers after a stow afore it fades.
wdl.settings.option.render_unsaved_outli: Outlines th' coffers ye haven't opened yet this plunder, so ye can see which coffers still need openin'.
wdl.settings.option.outline_distance.too: How far th' coffer outline reaches from ye, in blocks.
wdl.settings.option.unscanned_color.tool: Outline hue fer a coffer still missin' from th' stow.
wdl.settings.option.recovered_color.tool: Outline color fer a coffer salvaged from an earlier plunder.
wdl.settings.option.outline_line_width_s: Thickness o' th' outline, as a multiple o' th' game's standard.
wdl.settings.option.render_coverage_over:
Highlights th' already-stowed chunks on yer minimap an' world map while a plunder runs.
One color marks chunks stowed wi' their beasties; th' other marks chunks that never came close enough fer th' ship to send 'em. Sail back up close to fill 'em in.
wdl.settings.option.overlay_covered_colo: Highlight hue fer a chunk stowed along wi' its booty holders, portraits, an' stands o' armor.
wdl.settings.option.overlay_suspect_colo: Highlight hue fer a chunk whose terrain be stowed but whose beasties may yet be missin'. Th' range be gauged live from th' beasties arrivin' nearby, so a chunk can come clear once enough be spied.
wdl.settings.option.show_toasts.tooltip: Pops a holler in th' corner when a plunder finishes or fails, even wit' th' chat hidden.
wdl.settings.option.show_chat_messages.t: Shows th' mod's chat notices, like th' new-version-ready line.
wdl.settings.option.check_for_updates.to: When ye set sail, checks fer a newer version an' says so if one be found. One wee nameless request.
wdl.settings.option.world_type.tooltip:
What fills th' space between plundered chunks.
NOTHIN' leaves it empty; SEAS N' MOUNTAINS an' FLA'R THAN THE SEA make their own terrain, which won't match th' ship's.
wdl.settings.option.world_seed.tooltip: Th' lay o' th' land fer SEAS N' MOUNTAINS an' FLA'R THAN THE SEA terrain; any whole number works. NOTHIN' pays it no mind.
wdl.settings.option.generate_features.to: Makes structures (villages, th' End rooms, an' th' rest) in SEAS N' MOUNTAINS an' FLA'R THAN THE SEA terrain.
wdl.settings.option.override_gamerules.t:
Writes a hand-picked, safe set o' rules o' th' sea into th' plunder.
Disablin' writes none, so th' sea's own standards stand.
wdl.settings.option.override_world_defau:
Applies th' plunder's game mode an' foul sailin' settin's.
Disablin' opens it in th' game mode ye be in wit' foul sailin' off.
wdl.settings.option.open_in_creative.too:
Opens th' plundered sea in aimless sailin'.
Disablin' opens it in th' game mode ye were in.
Applies only under Override th' sea standards.
wdl.settings.option.allow_commands.toolt:
Allow foul sailin' in th' plunder so /gamemode an' /tp work.
Applies only under Override th' sea standards.
wdl.settings.option.auto_download.toolti: Starts a plunder on its own as soon as ye board a ship wit' yer mates.
wdl.settings.option.capture_entities.too: Stows beasties, booty holders, portraits, an' th' treasure maps they carry.
wdl.settings.option.capture_containers.t: Stows th' contents o' coffers, barrrels, an' the like ye open.
wdl.settings.option.recapture_chunks.too:
How fresh th' plunder keeps th' sea as ye sail.

Ne'er: Plunder each area once an' keep it as ye first spied it.
Nigh: Th' waters around ye stay fresh; areas ye've left keep their first plunder.

All o'er: Areas ye revisit be freshened too, but a coffer keeps its old loot till ye reopen it.
wdl.settings.option.lock_downloaded_maps:
Lock plundered treasure maps so they keep their picture.
Disablin' lets 'em repaint o'er th' surroundin' waters; with th' default NOTHIN' they repaint blank.
wdl.settings.option.remap_map_ids.toolti:
Give yer treasure maps steady Ids so a ship that renumbers its map Ids can't muddle 'em when ye press on.
Disablin' keeps th' ship's own map Ids in th' plunder.
wdl.settings.option.capture_advancements: Stows yer accomplishments, tied t' yer account.
wdl.settings.option.capture_statistics.t: Stows yer ship's manifest, tied t' yer account.
wdl.settings.option.skip_void_chunks.too: Throws overboard a plundered chunk that be completely empty t' save space. A chunk holdin' anythin' at all be kept.
wdl.settings.option.save_player_inventor: Stows yer loot bag, so whoever opens th' plunder inherits yer gear.
wdl.settings.option.save_player_ender_ch: Stows yer Ender coffer, but only while ye have it open durin' th' plunder.
wdl.settings.option.save_item_coordinate:
Keep th' marks stowed on yer items (wayfindin' rock marks, bee berths in th' vessel o' bee).
Disablin' blanks 'em so they don't give away yer whereabouts.
wdl.settings.option.zip_on_resume.toolti:
Afore pressin' on or haulin' back changes an existing folder, stow it as a ZIP first:
-pre-resume.zip afore pressin' on, -singleplayer.zip afore a haul-back.
wdl.settings.option.confirm_resume.toolt:
Ask afore pressin' on into an existin' folder.
Disablin' skips th' askin'.
wdl.settings.option.block_tainted_resume:
Belay pressin' on into a sea that was opened on a lonely voyage (it may carry chunks made on yer own, not from th' ship).
Disablin' warns and asks instead o' belayin'.
wdl.settings.option.zip_on_finish.toolti:
When a plunder finishes, also stows a shareable .zip alongside th' folder.
That zip be also th' clean backup a haul-back recovers from.
wdl.settings.option.append_date_suffix.t: Adds a -YYYY-MM-DD date t' a new plunder's name, so plunders made on different days sit side by side.
wdl.settings.option.force_mob_persistenc: Keeps every plundered beastie from wanderin' off natural-like, even th' common ones that'd stray off on their own.
wdl.settings.option.recapture_seconds.to:
How often th' plunder freshens th' loaded chunks around ye.
A longer spell saves work but be slower t' catch a change further out.
Th' 3×3 chunks around ye freshen ev'ry second regardless.
wdl.settings.option.encode_budget_millis:
How much time each tick th' plunder spends stowin'.
Higher keeps th' stow caught up when ye sail fast; lower be easier on yer ship speed.
wdl.settings.option.dump_received_frames: Deep-water diagnostic: dump every received booty holder's position t' a file fer a plunder-loss audit. Leave off fer normal use.
wdl.settings.option.outline_debug_timing: Deep-water diagnostic: log th' coffer outline's per-frame an' per-tick cost. Leave off fer normal use.
wdl.settings.gamerule.mob_griefing: Allow scallywags t' try t' sink ship
wdl.settings.confirm.capture.title: Batten down %s?
wdl.settings.confirm.capture_entities.me:
Th' plunder won't include beasties, booty holders, portraits, or th' treasure maps they carry,
so th' finished sea will be missin' 'em.
Coffers, barrrels, an' the like will plunder empty,
so th' finished sea will be missin' their booty.
wdl.settings.confirm.recapture.title: Change course t' %s?
wdl.settings.confirm.recapture.to_nearby:
Areas ye revisit won't be re-plundered, so yer first plunder o' them be kept;
th' waters around ye stay fresh as they change.
wdl.settings.confirm.recapture.to_off.me:
Each area be plundered once an' kept as ye first spied it;
later changes, even ones right around ye, won't be plundered.
wdl.settings.defaults.title: Set yer scribbles back t' standard?
wdl.settings.defaults.message: All yer scribbles will sail back t' their standard values.
wdl.settings.discard.title: Throw yer changes overboard?
wdl.settings.discard.message: Unsaved scribbles will be thrown overboard.
